The '''PTR-3 Vedette''' was a single-seater [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighter]] developed by [[Core Galaxy Systems]] in times of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Standoff on Leritor" />

[[Professor/Legends|Profex]] [[Rynalla]] owned two ''Vedettes'' and used them in her slave raids in the planet [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]].<ref name="Standoff on Leritor" />
